Location collection and display are state-gated, time-bounded and consent/policy controlled.
ETA includes freshness and uncertainty; stale or unavailable location is shown explicitly rather than inventing a live position.

title: Professional academy and skill assessment
description: Deliver structured onboarding, learning modules and service-specific skill assessments linked to professional qualification and periodic review.
acceptance: Professionals complete versioned training and assessments before restricted service categories are enabled.
Assessment attempts, evidence, reviewer decisions and qualification expiry are auditable.
Failed, expired or revoked qualifications block matching and acceptance deterministically.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Professional CRM and business reporting
description: Provide professionals with customer/job records, invoice creation and income summaries scoped to their own work and permitted organization memberships.
acceptance: Professionals can create and retrieve job/customer records only for authorized assignments and consented relationships.
Invoices and income reports reconcile to immutable order and ledger references; they cannot alter ledger postings.
Exports are tenant-scoped, auditable and redact data outside the professional's authorization.

title: Offline-first professional critical workflows
description: Support bounded offline work for the professional's critical workflow with an encrypted local queue and safe replay when connectivity returns.
acceptance: Permitted checklist, job notes and status intents can be captured offline with stable idempotency keys.
Sync revalidates identity, assignment, offer expiry, order state and financial/safety guards before applying mutations.
Conflicts are visible and recoverable; offline state never grants new authorization or claims an unconfirmed server mutation succeeded.

title: Ranked matching and fair offer distribution
description: Rank eligible professionals using configured distance, skill, quality, availability and fairness signals without bypassing deterministic eligibility gates.
acceptance: Ranking is applied only after hard tenant, market, skill, verification and availability filters.
Ranking inputs, weights/version and tie-break rules are explainable and auditable.
Fairness constraints and bounded exploration are tested against starvation and concentration regressions.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Commission incentives penalties and customer credits
description: Implement versioned commission, reward, penalty, coupon and credit rules as deterministic financial inputs with immutable ledger consequences.
acceptance: Rules are market-scoped, versioned, effective-dated and previewable before activation.
Every applied adjustment has an idempotency key, actor/reason and balanced ledger postings or explicit non-cash entitlement.
Refunds and reversals compensate original postings; rule edits never mutate historical transactions.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Background checks and periodic credential review
description: Manage market-specific background-check evidence and recurring professional credential reviews with expiry and adverse-result escalation.
acceptance: Required checks are configured by market and service risk, with explicit provider adapters and local fakes.
Evidence references, consent, reviewer decisions, expiry and recheck history are auditable without storing unnecessary raw sensitive data.
Expired, revoked or failed checks block eligible dispatch until an authorized review resolves the case.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Masked virtual voice and call-session adapter
description: Provide order-scoped virtual voice sessions with number masking through market-configured communications providers.
acceptance: Only eligible order participants can initiate or join a call session during configured order states.
Real phone numbers remain hidden from counterparties and call metadata is access-controlled and auditable.
Provider failures, timeout, session expiry and abuse/rate limits are covered by offline adapter contract tests.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Order operations console and guarded interventions
description: Provide operators with an observable order state machine, work queues and audited manual interventions under explicit role and step-up controls.
acceptance: Operators can inspect order timeline, pending offers, payment/ledger references and blockers within their tenant and market scope.
Manual interventions require an allowed transition, reason and any configured second approval; invalid transitions fail closed.
Every intervention emits an immutable audit record and idempotent domain event.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Consent retention and secret lifecycle governance
description: Provide explicit consent records, adopter-configured data retention policies and secret/key lifecycle integrations without inventing legal retention periods.
acceptance: Consent is purpose-specific, versioned, timestamped, revocable and enforced by downstream communication/data access.
Retention policies are market/legal-entity configurable, reviewed and auditable; no default duration is invented by the platform.
Secrets are injected from supported secret managers, rotated without repository exposure and never written to logs or telemetry.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. Policy-dependent behavior remains blocked until an adopter supplies valid policy.

title: Customer Intake Copilot
description: Transform customer text and permitted images into a structured service request, ask only necessary follow-up questions and propose a transparent non-binding estimate.
acceptance: Outputs conform to a versioned schema and cite the catalog/policy context used for suggestions.
Missing or ambiguous fields trigger bounded follow-up questions; low-confidence extraction is visibly marked for customer confirmation.
AI cannot submit an order, set a binding price or change safety/financial state without deterministic validation and explicit customer/human approval.
PII is redacted before external model calls and every supported model/provider path has a local fake and golden evaluation set.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted.

title: Operational demand supply and finance dashboards
description: Provide role-scoped operator dashboards for order operations, regional demand/supply and financial performance using canonical, privacy-classified analytics projections.
acceptance: Dashboards consume versioned tenant/market-scoped projections rather than querying another module's operational tables.
Each metric exposes source, numerator/denominator where applicable, time window, timezone, freshness and projection version.
Finance metrics reconcile to ledger/projection references; sensitive customer/provider details are minimized and access is audited.
notes: Added during full-product gap decomposition on 2026-11-23. not implemented or maintainer-accepted; dashboards depend on canonical analytics projections.

title: Approved tenant-scoped support knowledge base
description: Manage versioned support knowledge articles with explicit review/publication authority and expose only approved, market/locale-matched revisions through a tenant-safe retrieval boundary.
acceptance: Authors, reviewers and publishers require distinct explicit capabilities; tenant articles are visible only within their owning tenant, while platform articles require a dedicated platform content-management grant.
Draft, review, publish and retire transitions are guarded and append-only audited; published revisions are immutable and corrections create a new revision.

Retrieval returns only approved, active revisions matching the authenticated tenant scope, market and locale, with article/revision/policy provenance; cross-tenant and unpublished content never appears.
Publication, revision mutation and audit append are atomic; concurrent publication cannot overwrite a newer revision or publish the same revision twice.
Missing authorization, invalid state, retrieval outage or ambiguous scope fails closed without falling back to drafts or another tenant's content.
notes: Decomposed from Issue #13 into implementation task #305. Specification/backlog record only; no knowledge-base implementation or maintainer acceptance is claimed.

title: Operator-approved support case escalation
description: Provide tenant-scoped escalation policy and SLA-risk queues with explicitly approved, auditable case escalation and notification intents.
acceptance: Escalation policies are tenant-scoped, versioned and effective-dated; SLA candidates derive only from persisted case deadlines and configured thresholds.
Candidate generation creates alerts only; assignment, priority, escalation level, case state and customer notification change only after an authorized operator approves with a reason.
Policy administration, candidate reads and approval require separate explicit tenant-scoped grants and active same-tenant support-agent membership; cross-tenant actors, cases and targets fail closed.
Approval, case mutation, append-only audit and transactional outbox intent commit atomically with idempotency; duplicate scheduler/approval attempts cannot duplicate consequential effects.
Stale case versions, revoked grants, inactive targets, ambiguous policies, worker/clock failures and notification-provider failures remain visible and fail safely without autonomous escalation.
notes: Decomposed from Issue #13 into implementation task #307. Specification/backlog record only; no escalation implementation or maintainer acceptance is claimed.
